scripts.dev: node scripts/ensure-native-modules.mjs && cross-env NODE_ENV=development dotenv --no-expand -c development -- node --conditions=source --import tsx packages/scripts/src/commands/run-dev.ts
scripts.start: cross-env NODE_ENV=production dotenv --no-expand -c production -- node --conditions=source --import tsx scripts/start-bb.mjs
scripts.start:worktree: cross-env NODE_ENV=development dotenv --no-expand -c development -- node --conditions=source --import tsx packages/scripts/src/commands/run-dev.ts --worktree
scripts.dev:host-daemon: cross-env NODE_ENV=development dotenv --no-expand -c development -- node --conditions=source --import tsx packages/scripts/src/commands/run-host-daemon.ts
scripts.reset: cross-env NODE_ENV=production pnpm run --silent scripts:prepare && cross-env NODE_ENV=production node packages/scripts/dist/commands/reset-bb-data.js
scripts.reset:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development pnpm run --silent scripts:prepare && cross-env NODE_ENV=development node packages/scripts/dist/commands/reset-bb-data.js
scripts.reset:all: cross-env NODE_ENV=production pnpm run --silent scripts:prepare && cross-env NODE_ENV=production node packages/scripts/dist/commands/reset-bb-data.js --all
scripts.bb: cross-env NODE_ENV=production pnpm run --silent cli:prepare 1>&2 && cross-env NODE_ENV=production node packages/scripts/dist/commands/run-cli.js
